snippet.title: FROG IN THE HOLE! - Trailer
snippet.description: Sacrifice frogs to the hole. In this incremental automation sandbox, you'll build physics-based factories, to scale from manual tossing to managing a chaotic swarm of frogs. Magnetize, expand, pray at the altar, and chain combos to become worthy of the FROG GOD. What happens to the frogs?
